an7.82:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] sattahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato vinayadharo sobhati.
an7.82:1.7: anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati. seyyathīdaṃ: ekampi jātiṃ dvepi jātiyo …pe… iti sākāraṃ sauddesaṃ anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati.
an7.82:1.8: dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena …pe… yathākammūpage satte pajānāti.
an7.82:1.10: imehi kho bhikkhave, sattahi dhammehi samannāgato vinayadharo sobhatīti.
